title: VTC — shared join-request definitions
description: Shared types for the vtc/join-requests/* spec family. JoinRequest is the community's view of one pending or decided application to join.

JoinRequest.title: JoinRequest
JoinRequest.description: One application to join a Verifiable Trust Community.

id.description: Stable id of this join request (a UUID).

vp.description: The W3C Verifiable Presentation the applicant submitted (opaque here).

policyDecision.description: The community policy verdict recorded for this request (opaque here); absent while pending.

registryConsent.description: Whether the applicant consented to trust-registry publication.
